query: Why am I not allowed to do a CPF transfer to my extended family members (e.g. uncles/aunts/cousins)?
reference_answer: The CPF system is meant to provide for and safeguard your individual retirement adequacy. Hence we must be careful when considering allowing CPF transfers to extended family members, beyond immediate family members such as your parents, spouse and siblings. Meanwhile, you can consider using cash to top up to your extended family member's CPF account instead.

Cash top-ups are not allowed, except in the case of taking up entitlements (e.g. rights shares) or conversion of entitlements. You may top-up your CPF Investment Account through your agent bank if you have insufficient CPF savings or stock limit to subscribe for the entitlements or conversion. However, such cash top-ups are not withdrawable or refundable, even if your applications are unsuccessful.
answer: You are not allowed to transfer CPF to extended family members like uncles, aunts, or cousins. Instead, you can use cash to top up their CPF accounts. CPF transfers are restricted to immediate family members. [Document 1]
